overview: After dinner you wrote three sentences. The king is come down. The lords look at his hands. He looks at the ground. You left the foot of the page blank. You did not write a glass.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the three sentences and pounced them.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Wrote that the king is come down and looks at the ground

summary: Wrote that the king is come down and looks at the ground
